capabilities: Open map folders of Markdown notes as visual mind maps
Import maps from an Emberly Markdown export
Create new maps from the command palette
Click topics to open their notes and resources
Return to the plain note editor from a map
disambiguation: Not geographic maps; "maps" here are mind maps where topics branch into notes, bookmarks and files.
extras: Requires desktop Obsidian 1.13.7 or newer; the map must be reopened after restarting Obsidian. No account, paid features, ads, tracking, or donation prompts; works offline.
intentEvidence: Since we're shutting Emberly down, we made this to give our users somewhere to bring their maps.
motivation: The Emberly app is shutting down, so the authors built this to give existing users somewhere to bring their maps and to keep the polished mind map engine available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and navigate a set of notes as a visual, growing mind map where each topic is a home for notes and resources.

relations.evidence: Since we're shutting Emberly down, we made this to give our users somewhere to bring their maps.

summary: Mind map plugin that opens folders of Markdown notes as Emberly-style knowledge trees, with topics linking to notes, bookmarks and files.
